test_delete_timedelta_index: test the TimedeltaIndex.delete() method to remove elements by index and verify preserved frequency
test_delete_timedelta_slice: test the TimedeltaIndex.delete() method with slice arguments to remove ranges of elements
test_delete_preserves_name: test TimedeltaIndex.delete() preserves the index name after deletion
test_delete_resets_freq: test that TimedeltaIndex.delete() resets freq to None when the resulting index is no longer regular
test_delete_no_freq_inference: test that TimedeltaIndex.delete() does not infer freq when the original index has None freq
